chief_complaint: Cardiovascular risk management and post‑myocardial infarction follow‑up in the context of type 2 diabetes and metabolic syndrome
history_of_present_illness: The patient is a 77‑year‑old woman with a recent (January 2023) myocardial infarction and ongoing pre‑infarction syndrome. She has type 2 diabetes diagnosed in 2020 with a current A1c of 6.9%, peripheral neuropathy, obesity (BMI ≥ 30), hypertension treated with losartan, hyperlipidemia and hypertriglyceridemia managed with duplicate statin therapy, and metabolic syndrome. She reports increasing stress, social isolation, and limited social contact since September 2022. Osteoarthritis of the hip limits mobility. Anemia has been chronic since 1969. Recent visits have focused on wellness and retinal imaging, but vital signs, lipid panels, and renal function are missing. Polypharmacy is moderate with six distinct agents, and there are gaps in documented anti‑diabetic and antihypertensive regimens.

active_problems.name: Neuropathy due to type 2 diabetes mellitus
